definition: the pictures printed in a book
description: A young woman with her hair in a bun, a grey shirt and a black top holds up a printed page showing a blue moth and pins it onto a wall covered in neatly pinned book pages, where pictures of flowers, fruit and insects sit between columns of text. She smooths the page flat with her hand and looks at it with a smile. On the table in front lie stacks of prints, brushes in jars and a tin of pins, while another woman works on a ladder and a third sits at a desk behind, in a bright studio with tall windows.
